item.desc: One thing I like about eating in China is that a restaurant doesn’t need expensive design to be popular. People sit close together, share dishes, talk loudly, drink, laugh, and stay for hours. The focus is not on the interior — it’s on food, people, and atmosphere. Sometimes the simplest places feel the most alive. Would you choose this or a luxury restaurant? 👇 #NickitaChina #China #ChineseFood #StreetRestaurant #LifeInChina
